title: Product Page Presentation

fields.label: Quantity Heading
fields.name: quantity_heading
fields.instructions: Used for products marked Featured in WooCommerce when no custom product badge is set.

fields.label: Featured Badge Label
fields.name: best_seller_label
fields.instructions: Used for products marked Featured in WooCommerce when no custom product badge is set.

fields.label: Free Shipping Message
fields.name: free_shipping_message
fields.instructions: Displayed with the threshold below on product pages.

fields.label: In stock label
fields.name: in_stock_label
fields.instructions: Product cards and the hero quick order card, for products in stock.

fields.label: Out of stock label
fields.name: out_of_stock_label
fields.instructions: Product cards and the hero quick order card, for products out of stock.

fields.label: Price per tablet label
fields.name: per_tab_label
fields.instructions: After the price per tablet on homepage product cards.

fields.label: Add to cart button
fields.name: add_to_cart_label
fields.instructions: Button on homepage product cards and the hero quick order card.

fields.label: Details button
fields.name: details_label
fields.instructions: Outline button to the product page on homepage product cards (tablet and desktop).

fields.label: Reviews: tag above the heading
fields.name: product_reviews_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small tag above the reviews heading on product pages.

fields.label: Reviews: heading
fields.name: product_reviews_heading
fields.instructions: Heading of the reviews section on product pages.

fields.label: Reviews: rating label (default)
fields.name: product_reviews_label_default
fields.instructions: Above the average score when the product has no rating.

fields.label: Reviews: rating label 4.5 and above
fields.name: product_reviews_label_excellent
fields.instructions: Above the average score.

fields.label: Reviews: rating label 4.0 to 4.4
fields.name: product_reviews_label_great
fields.instructions: Above the average score.

fields.label: Reviews: rating label 3.0 to 3.9
fields.name: product_reviews_label_average
fields.instructions: Above the average score.

fields.label: Reviews: rating label below 3.0
fields.name: product_reviews_label_poor
fields.instructions: Above the average score.

fields.label: Reviews: score line
fields.name: product_reviews_based_on
fields.instructions: Under the average score. {count} is the number of reviews.

fields.label: Reviews: star bar label
fields.name: product_reviews_star_bar_label
fields.instructions: Label of each bar in the star breakdown. {star} is 5 to 1.

fields.label: Reviews: stars (screen readers)
fields.name: product_reviews_stars_aria
fields.instructions: Read aloud for star rows. {rating} is the rating.

fields.label: Reviews: previous arrow (screen readers)
fields.name: product_reviews_prev_label
fields.instructions: Read aloud for the left arrow.

fields.label: Reviews: next arrow (screen readers)
fields.name: product_reviews_next_label
fields.instructions: Read aloud for the right arrow.

fields.label: Reviews: list (screen readers)
fields.name: product_reviews_slider_label
fields.instructions: Read aloud for the row of review cards.

fields.label: Reviews: verified badge
fields.name: product_reviews_badge_verified
fields.instructions: Badge on a review marked Verified Buyer.

fields.label: Reviews: other badge
fields.name: product_reviews_badge_review
fields.instructions: Badge on a review that is not marked Verified Buyer.

fields.label: Review form: heading
fields.name: product_reviews_form_heading
fields.instructions: Heading above the review form.

fields.label: Review form: product text
fields.name: product_reviews_form_for
fields.instructions: After the heading. {product} is the product name.

fields.label: Review form: rating label
fields.name: product_reviews_form_rating_label
fields.instructions: Above the star buttons.

fields.label: Review form: stars group (screen readers)
fields.name: product_reviews_form_rating_aria
fields.instructions: Read aloud for the group of star buttons.

fields.label: Review form: one star button (screen readers)
fields.name: product_reviews_form_star_aria
fields.instructions: Read aloud for each star button.

fields.label: Review form: required note
fields.name: product_reviews_form_required_note
fields.instructions: Next to the submit button.

fields.label: Review form: moderation note
fields.name: product_reviews_form_moderated
fields.instructions: Under the submit button.

fields.label: Review form message: no rating chosen
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_pick_rating
fields.instructions: Shown if the visitor submits without choosing stars.

fields.label: Review form message: sending
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_submitting
fields.instructions: Button text while the review is being sent.

fields.label: Review form message: could not submit
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_failed
fields.default_value: Your review could not be submitted. Please try again.

fields.label: Review form message: network error
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_network
fields.default_value: A network error occurred. Please try again.

fields.label: Review form message: session expired
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_session
fields.default_value: Your session expired. Refresh the page and try again.
fields.instructions: Sent by the server.

fields.label: Review form message: product not available
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_unavailable
fields.default_value: This product is not available for reviews.
fields.instructions: Sent by the server.

fields.label: Review form message: fields missing
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_incomplete
fields.default_value: Please complete each field and choose a valid rating.
fields.instructions: Sent by the server.

fields.label: Review form message: could not save
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_save_failed
fields.default_value: Your review could not be saved. Please try again.
fields.instructions: Sent by the server.

fields.label: Review form message: thank you
fields.name: product_reviews_msg_thanks
fields.default_value: Thank you. Your review has been submitted and is pending moderation.
fields.instructions: Shown after a review is sent.

description: Editable labels and shipping/trust messages used on WooCommerce product pages.
